teleology: Capture crowd-implied probabilities and repricing velocity at T-n so the system can detect what is already priced versus what remains open.
mechanism: Runs tools.polymarket.polymarket and buckets markets into category tables with probability, change, volume, conviction, and slug fields.
expectation: Return a POLYMARKET artifact organized by category and bucket with q, o, p, c, v, s, and slug-style fields. Markets should preserve enough structure to test pre-pricing and crowd divergence.
